basic_details.job_title: DLSA Sangrur Para Legal Volunteer Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline

qualification.details: Applicants must be volunteers willing to work with District Legal Services Authority, Sangrur or Sub Divisional Legal Services Committees, Sunam, Dhuri, and Munak. Applicants must not have any criminal or civil litigation pending against them in any judicial court, and must not have ever been convicted by any judicial court. Applicants must not be active political enthusiasts of any political party.

vacancy_details.details: The notification invites applications for Para Legal Volunteers (Para Legal Volunteers) on a voluntary basis for the District Legal Services Authority, Sangrur and Sub Divisional Legal Services Committees at Sunam, Dhuri, and Munak. The exact number of vacancies is not specified in the notification.

salary_details.pay_scale: Honorarium per day of work as per rules
salary_details.para legal volunteer: Honorarium from time to time as fixed by the authority, paid only for the days actually worked. No salary, remuneration, or wages are admissible.

how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application form and format provided along with the official notification PDF.
Fill in all mandatory details including name, parent's name, date of birth, category, address, and educational qualifications.
Affix a self-attested passport-size photograph on the designated space of the application form.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as educational certificates, category proofs, and residential proofs.
Ensure the self-declaration regarding no criminal cases and non-political affiliation is signed and completed at the bottom of the form.
Submit the completed application form either personally or by post to the Office of the District Legal Services Authority, Samjhota Sadan, Sangrur on or before 19 October 2026 by 04:00 PM.
important_instructions: Para Legal Volunteers will be utilised for various activities by DLSA Sangrur or Sub Divisional Legal Services Committees at Sunam, Dhuri, and Munak as per requirement. Selected candidates will receive honorarium strictly on days worked as per norms and not a regular monthly salary. Applications received after 04:00 PM on 19 October 2026 will not be accepted. Applicants must fulfill all specified eligibility categories to be considered by the selection committee.

content_sections.heading: DLSA Sangrur Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notification invites applications for Para Legal Volunteers (Para Legal Volunteers) on a voluntary basis for the District Legal Services Authority, Sangrur and Sub Divisional Legal Services Committees at Sunam, Dhuri, and Munak. The exact number of vacancies is not specified in the notification.

content_sections.heading: DLSA Sangrur Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must be volunteers willing to work with District Legal Services Authority, Sangrur or Sub Divisional Legal Services Committees, Sunam, Dhuri, and Munak. Applicants must not have any criminal or civil litigation pending against them in any judicial court, and must not have ever been convicted by any judicial court. Applicants must not be active political enthusiasts of any political party.

rows.qualification_required: Eligible categories include Teachers (including retired teachers), Retired Government servants and senior citizens, M.S.W. students and teachers, Anganwadi Workers, Doctors/Physicians, Students & Law Students (till they enroll as lawyers), Members of non-political, service-oriented NGOs and Clubs, Members of Women Neighborhood Groups, Maithri Sanghams and other Self Help Groups including marginalized/vulnerable groups, Educated prisoners with good behavior serving long-term sentences, and any other literate person (preferably matriculate) interested in social service. Minimum matriculate or higher qualification depending on the category.

rows.pay_level_pay: Honorarium from time to time as fixed by the authority, paid only for the days actually worked. No salary, remuneration, or wages are admissible.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DLSA Sangrur Recruitment
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed application form and format provided along with the official notification PDF. Fill in all mandatory details including name, parent's name, date of birth, category, address, and educational qualifications. Affix a self-attested passport-size photograph on the designated space of the application form. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as educational certificates, category proofs, and residential proofs. Ensure the self-declaration regarding no criminal cases and non-political affiliation is signed and completed at the bottom of the form. Submit the completed application form either personally or by post to the Office of the District Legal Services Authority, Samjhota Sadan, Sangrur on or before 19 October 2026 by 04:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of educational qualification certificates Self-attested copy of category certificate (SC/ST/BC/Minority) Self-attested copy of residential address proof Self-attested copies of work experience certificates (if any) Passport-size photograph for self-attested photo affixation on the form

content_sections.heading: DLSA Sangrur Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Para Legal Volunteers will be utilised for various activities by DLSA Sangrur or Sub Divisional Legal Services Committees at Sunam, Dhuri, and Munak as per requirement. Selected candidates will receive honorarium strictly on days worked as per norms and not a regular monthly salary. Applications received after 04:00 PM on 19 October 2026 will not be accepted. Applicants must fulfill all specified eligibility categories to be considered by the selection committee.

faq.question: Q1. What is the extended last date to apply for DLSA Sangrur Para Legal Volunteer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications has been extended to 19 October 2026 up to 04:00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. Where should the application form be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted to the Office of the District Legal Services Authority, Samjhota Sadan, Sangrur.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: The total number of vacancies is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for DLSA Sangrur PLV recruitment?
faq.answer: No, the notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q5. Who is eligible to apply as a Para Legal Volunteer?
faq.answer: Teachers, retired government servants, senior citizens, MSW students/teachers, Anganwadi workers, doctors, law students, NGO members, SHG members, and literate individuals interested in social service are eligible.

faq.question: Q6. Are active political party members eligible to apply?
faq.answer: No, applicants must not be active political enthusiasts of any political party.

faq.question: Q7. Can candidates with pending criminal cases apply?
faq.answer: No, candidates against whom any civil or criminal litigation is pending or who have been convicted by a judicial court are not eligible.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted in offline mode using the prescribed application format.
